summary: The prepared main checkout already contains the issue-specific solution merged by upstream PR #30260 after the report: Qwen preprocessing supplies video metadata, filters SGLang-owned sampling keys before the Hugging Face call, and passes do_sample_frames=False. No duplicate source fix was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Four focused regressions covering Qwen preprocessed-video sampling-key removal, the unprocessed-video boundary, ordinary video kwargs injection, and filtered single-call routing; 4 passed and 46 were deselected. Raw output: reports/j-9fe87015ba91/raw/focused_tests.log

Actual checked-out Qwen config filtering and BaseMultimodalProcessor call kwargs: fps/max_frames were absent after preprocessing, do_normalize remained, do_sample_frames was false; Transformers 5.12.1 independently merged the false flag into video kwargs. Raw output: reports/j-9fe87015ba91/raw/routing_reproduction.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and existing fix are CPU-side preprocessing/keyword routing. No Qwen-VL weights were available, and the tiny Llama transport fixture cannot qualify Qwen-VL frame sampling or visual-token counts.

remaining_limitations: No Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5-VL model weights were available, so a full serving-path visual-token count comparison was not performed.
The original NVIDIA H20 environment was unavailable; no claim of matching the reporter's GPU/model reproduction is made.

The prepared environment uses Transformers 5.12.1 rather than the reporter's 5.8.1, though SGLang's current Qwen-specific filtering independently removes the reported fps/max_frames trigger before that boundary.
